0.0: Hello, #b#h0##k. The #rLegends Awards#k has hit Maple World in a big way, and everyone is going crazy for Legendary stuff. I was thinking of how I could get in on the fun, and then it hit me! My mother's uncle's step-brother's babysitter's grandfather was a certified fruit juice master, and he passed his\n\n#i04162006# #rSecret Legendary Fruit Juice Recipe#k down to me. With this recipe, we can become legendary fruit juice masters! Will you join me, #b#h0##k, on my journey into legend?

no.0: Really? Perhaps you don't understand how honored and respected fruit juice masters are...

yes.0: I made a bunch of copies of the recipe book, so I've given you one, #b#h0##k. You have your own #r#k now, right?\n\nSo, let's make you a legendary fruit juice master! This will be a long and intense process, with many pitfalls and challenges along the way, but I know you can do it! There are #b4 fruit juice recipes#k in the book I gave you. Let's start with the easiest one, #rStrawberry Juice#k. Work hard, and focus on your juice mastery. #bYou will become a Strawberry Juice Master after making Strawberry Juice 3 times.#k
